title: Step sampling and terminal-step oversampling (p_terminal) in harnessed variants
question: For the step-by-step harnessed variants (cls, step_fork, step_ar, addressed_step_ar), how does sampling one column step k per generated problem with terminal-step oversampling (p_terminal = 0.2 vs. 0.0) compare against yielding all K + 1 steps of each problem sequentially for sample efficiency and halt_accuracy?
